title: The remaining XLSX worksheet MCE rewrite proof charges declarations per tag and admits safe bound attributes
authority: decision 1 of change 0652, carrying the MCE rewrite row from change 0651; change 0657's D4 supplies the admitted attribute contract
code_state: crates/litchi-xlsx raw worksheet admission and focused tests; no public API, dependency, unsafe code or parser limit changed
reason_codes: 0653 explicitly left MceRewriteEquivalence's cumulative declaration budget and stale writer description behind after the namespace writer changed
0657 D4 admits unfamiliar attributes outside composed spans and preserves them byte for byte, so a bound prefixed attribute can be admitted when the worksheet parser ignores it
the proof still refuses prefixed elements and every MCE directive that can remove or unwrap content, preserving the source-versus-processed event contract
the declaration witness spreads 288 declarations over 96 start tags: it exceeds the old cumulative accounting while staying within quick-xml's 256 declarations per tag
the real worksheet census is the retained measurement: 205 parts, 71 borrowed, 30 rewritten candidates, 25 validator-backed shared completions and 104 admission fallbacks

adjacent query-table, auto-filter, data-validation and named-sheet-view consumers retain owned or namespace-adapted fragments whose publication contracts do not admit a borrowed slice without a separate design

accepted_evidence.adversarial: focused shared-traversal tests cover valid Ignorable plus a bound prefixed attribute, unbound and duplicate Ignorable prefixes, MCE-recursive Ignorable, ProcessContent, PreserveAttributes and the per-start declaration witness
accepted_evidence.preservation: authoritative-versus-admitted differential over every worksheet part keeps both successful stores and exact errors identical; the valid Ignorable fixture also opens and commits a source-backed no-op
accepted_evidence.admission_census: marker_admission_matches_the_authoritative_path_on_every_real_worksheet prints the 205-part borrowed, rewritten, shared-complete and fallback counts
accepted_evidence.marker_census: an independent ZIP read over test-data/ooxml/xlsx counts 130 mc:Ignorable, 104 dyDescent, three other MCE-directive and zero AlternateContent worksheet markers
accepted_evidence.limits: the unchanged source-size, event, XML-depth, quick-xml per-start declaration and MCE processing bounds remain covered by the existing boundary suite plus the new declaration witness
accepted_evidence.adjacent_consumer_audit: query_table/codec.rs, auto_filter/package.rs, data_validation/codec/wire.rs and named_sheet_view/codec.rs were inspected; no code change is justified without changing ownership, namespace-context or typed-publication contracts

accepted_costs.proof_work: the Rewritten path resolves bound prefixed attributes and validates Ignorable tokens without allocating a directive set; duplicate detection is bounded by the existing directive-token limit
accepted_costs.fallback_surface: dyDescent, AlternateContent, ProcessContent, PreserveElements, PreserveAttributes, MustUnderstand, unknown MCE attributes, prefixed elements and unbound prefixes remain fallback gates
accepted_costs.no_speed_claim: no release timing, allocation, RSS, cold-cache, throughput or cross-platform measurement was taken; the census is an admission measurement only

known_gaps.dy_descent: x14ac:dyDescent still needs the separate x14ac capture to be joined to the shared parser
known_gaps.alternate_content: branch selection remains authoritative because the source traversal cannot model dropped branches
known_gaps.process_content_prefix: the pre-existing prefixed-element refusal under ProcessContent remains pinned
known_gaps.consumer_slices: the four adjacent processed-buffer consumers remain unchanged and have no separate borrowed-fragment design
known_gaps.corpus_scope: the admission counts cover the repository's XLSX fixtures and do not generalize to external producers
known_gaps.performance: no wall-clock or allocation claim is registered

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, allocation, RSS, cold-cache, concurrency or cross-platform result
any claim that dyDescent or AlternateContent worksheets use the shared path
any claim that the four adjacent consumer slices can be borrowed safely

provenance.commit: the tip of perf/0666-mce-rewrite-residue; a commit cannot record its own hash
